intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Pearland for 2026, and here is what he found: 18 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Tree Lighting at Pearland Town Center) through December 20, with the Hometown Christmas Festival (December 4), the Hometown Christmas Parade (December 5) and Tour de Lites (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Pearland

  • 18 Christmas events for kids in Pearland
  • 3 free events: Hometown Christmas Festival, Hometown Christmas Parade and Christmas CollaboGanza (registration required)
  • Meet Santa: Hometown Christmas Festival (December 4) and Tree Lighting at Pearland Town Center (November 28)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Hometown Christmas Parade (December 5), Tree Lighting at Pearland Town Center (November 28)
  • Lights: Tour de Lites bike ride and hayride (December 12)
  • Season: November 28 to December 20

Planning a bigger day out? Pearland families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Houston, which covers Zoo Lights, Houston Ballet's Nutcracker and Children's Museum Houston.
